notes.title: First images of Holy Catch!
notes.content:
We are proud to share the first In Game images with you!

The game is still in development and we will do our best to release it by the end of the year.
The first demo version will also appear online around the end of the third quarter.
View the images below, they are also on the store page.
A new series of images will be shared with you soon.

Thank you for your patience and stay tuned!

notes.title: Unfortunately...
notes.content:
[h2]It was coming, and we didn't make it.
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789749/35f9234c8f187c166083d230e51ed20f332f45b5.png[/img]


We regret to inform you that Holy Catch The Star Night Story will not be released this year. 
According to our planning, we should start the first player test around this period. But we haven't achieved that, and we won't for a while.
Due to the size of the game, so much has been done and still needs to be done that it takes us a huge amount of time.

But don't worry, we will be working on it with the entire team so that we can still publish the game next year.
For the sake of clarity, we have created a Roadmap, which can be found below. You can also find our other projects.

We would like to keep you informed about the development of Holy Catch!

BluePlanetGames


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789749/d136dc65f384402871461e2a1758e02fdc69c4bb.png[/img]

notes.title: Exciting and important news about Holy Catch!
notes.content:
[u][b]Exciting and important news about Holy Catch!
[/b][/u]
After months of not giving an update, we have decided to give the game a different twist.

The game will get a stronger storyline and gameplay will also be completely changed. 2D like the images and the video would be completely overturned to 3D Platform.

As mentioned earlier, the game would be released at the end of this year. We will do everything we can to make this happen.

We will give you more information and the first gameplay footage in the coming weeks. So keep an eye on this shop page!

[i]Greetings BluePlanetGames[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43789749/5e85410c96399efd4e6017d8a1020b32820138b4.png[/img]
